title: UnitProgramDTO
description: UnitProgramDTO schema from Monitor Plan Management OpenAPI Specification

programId.description: The identifier for the program associated with the unit.

programCode.description: The code representing the specific program.

classCode.description: The code representing the class associated with the program.

unitMonitorCertBeginDate.description: The date when unit monitoring certification began for the program.

unitMonitorCertDeadline.description: The deadline date for completing unit monitoring certification.

emissionsRecordingBeginDate.description: The date when emissions recording began under the program.

endDate.description: The end date for the program's association with the unit.

id.description: The unique identifier for the unit program record.

unitId.description: The identifier for the unit associated with the program.

userId.description: The identifier for the user who last modified the record.

addDate.description: The timestamp when the unit program record was created.

updateDate.description: The timestamp when the unit program record was last updated.

active.description: Indicates whether the unit program is currently active.
